text: Route prefix: /opd. All OPD consultation features require permission: opd.view. The core component is OpdConsultationCrud (Livewire, with WithPagination + ChecksActiveEncounters traits). OPD is the most common patient encounter - it handles walk-in and scheduled outpatient visits.

Route: opd.visit-types (permission: opd.view). Visit types classify the patient's visit: New Visit, Follow-up Visit, Referral Visit, Emergency Follow-up, etc. Fields: id, name, code, description, is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns. Used in the consultation create form's visit_type_id field.

Route: opd.consultation-types (permission: opd.view). Types of consultations: General Consultation, Specialty Consultation, Follow-up Consultation, Urgent Consultation, etc. Fields: id, name, code, description, is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns. Used in consultation_type_id field.

Route: opd.referral-sources (permission: opd.view). Where the patient came from: Self-Referral, ER Referral, Hospital Admission, Other Hospital, HMO Referral, Workplace, School, etc. Fields: id, name, code, description, is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns. Optional field in consultation create form.
Route: opd.services (permission: opd.view). Clinical services offered by the OPD. Fields: id, name, code, description, is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns.

Route: opd.clinics (permission: opd.view). OPD clinics: General Clinic, Cardiac Clinic, Pediatric Clinic, Dermatology Clinic, etc. Each clinic belongs to a department (opdClinic->department_id). Fields: id, department_id, name, code, description, is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns. Used in opd_clinic_id field. The clinic's department_id is used when creating lab orders (requesting_department_id = consultation->opdClinic->department_id).

Route: opd.complaints (permission: opd.view). Common chief complaints for quick selection: Fever, Cough, Headache, Chest Pain, Abdominal Pain, Dizziness, etc. Fields: id, name, code, category, is_active, tenant_id, history, audit columns.

items: id - Primary key.
tenant_id - Foreign key to hospitals.id (multi-tenancy).
patient_id - FK to patients.id. The patient being consulted.

consultation_code - Unique consultation identifier. Auto-generated as 'OPD-' + 5-digit zero-padded sequence (e.g. OPD-00001, OPD-00002). Generated by generateConsultationCode($tid) method: finds last OPD consultation for tenant, parses numeric part after 'OPD-', increments, pads to 5 digits. Falls back to 'OPD-00001' if no existing consultation.
opd_clinic_id - FK to opd_clinics.id. The clinic where the consultation takes place.
attending_physician_id - FK to health_care_professionals.id. The doctor conducting the consultation.
consultation_type_id - FK to opd_consultation_types.id.
visit_type_id - FK to opd_visit_types.id.
referral_source_id - FK to opd_referral_sources.id (nullable).
consultation_datetime - DateTime. Set to now() on creation.
status - Consultation status: Pending, In Progress, Completed. Default: 'Pending'.
is_yakap - Boolean. Whether this is a YAKAP primary care consultation.
empanelment_id - FK to yakap_empanelments.id (nullable). Only set if is_yakap = true.
history_of_present_illness - Text (max 10000). HPI narrative.
physical_exam_findings - Text (max 10000). Physical examination findings.
assessment - Text (max 10000). Diagnosis/assessment.
treatment_plan - Text (max 10000). Planned treatment.
orders_summary - Text (max 10000). Summary of orders placed.
disposition - String. Outcome: Discharged, Admitted, Referred, Follow-up, etc.
next_follow_up_date - Date. Scheduled follow-up.
chief_complaint - String. Patient's primary complaint (set by nursing via vitals modal).
vital_bp_systolic - Integer (nullable). Blood pressure systolic.
vital_bp_diastolic - Integer (nullable). Blood pressure diastolic.
vital_heart_rate - Integer (nullable). Heart rate (bpm).
vital_temperature - Float (nullable). Temperature (Celsius).
vital_respiratory_rate - Integer (nullable). Respiratory rate (breaths/min).
vital_weight - Float (nullable). Weight (kg).
vital_height - Float (nullable). Height (cm).
vital_o2_saturation - Float (nullable). O2 saturation (%).
created_by / created_date - Audit columns.
updated_by / updated_date - Audit columns.
history - Soft delete flag (1=active).
is_active - Active flag.

text: From OpdConsultationCrud source code, openCreate() + saveEncounter():

items: openCreate(): Resets ALL form fields: patient_id, opd_clinic_id, attending_physician_id, consultation_type_id, visit_type_id, referral_source_id, empanelment_id, patient_search, selected_patient_name. Sets is_yakap=false, showCreateModal=true.

Patient search: The patient_search field triggers an autocomplete. As the user types (minimum 3 characters), the system searches patients by name, patient_code, philhealth number, and contact number. Results appear as a dropdown. When user selects a patient (selectPatient($id, $name)): sets patient_id, selected_patient_name, skipPatientSearchUpdate=true (to prevent unwanted re-firing), clears patient_search.
Fill in consultation details:
- opd_clinic_id: Select from OPD > Clinics master. Required.
- attending_physician_id: Select a healthcare professional (doctor). Required.
- consultation_type_id: Select from OPD > Consultation Types. Required.
- visit_type_id: Select from OPD > Visit Types. Required.
- referral_source_id: Optional. Select from OPD > Referral Sources.
- is_yakap: Toggle if this is a YAKAP primary care patient. If on, empanelment_id dropdown appears.
- empanelment_id: If is_yakap, select from YAKAP > Empanelments.
saveEncounter() validation (ALL required unless noted):
- patient_id: required|exists:patients,id
- opd_clinic_id: required|exists:opd_clinics,id
- attending_physician_id: required|exists:health_care_professionals,id
- consultation_type_id: required|exists:opd_consultation_types,id
- visit_type_id: required|exists:opd_visit_types,id
ensureNoActiveEncounter($this->patient_id): Checks that the patient does not already have an active (non-completed) OPD consultation. Prevents duplicate concurrent encounters.
Generates consultation_code via generateConsultationCode($tid): 'OPD-' + 5-digit zero-padded sequence.

Creates OpdConsultation with: tenant_id, patient_id, consultation_code, opd_clinic_id, attending_physician_id, consultation_type_id, visit_type_id, referral_source_id (nullable), consultation_datetime = now(), status = 'Pending', is_yakap, empanelment_id (if yakap), created_by = current user ID, created_date = now(), updated_by = current user ID, updated_date = now(), history = 1, is_active = true.
Closes create modal, flashes session message 'OPD Encounter created successfully.'
The SOAP form then opens for clinical documentation (see 6.4).

text: After creating the consultation, the SOAP form (treatConsultation + saveConsultation) captures the clinical notes. The treatConsultation($id) method loads the consultation WITH all related orders eager-loaded:

items: Loads: patient, opdClinic, attendingPhysician, labRequests.items.labTest, pharmacyRequests.items.drug, csrRequests.items.item, radiologyRequests.items.examType, procedureRequests.items.procedure
Pre-populates ALL SOAP fields from the existing record (null-safe).
chief_complaint - Patient's primary complaint (also set via Vitals modal by nursing).
vital_bp_systolic / vital_bp_diastolic - Blood pressure (mmHg).
vital_heart_rate - Heart rate (bpm).
vital_temperature - Temperature (Celsius).
vital_respiratory_rate - Respiratory rate (breaths/min).
vital_weight - Weight (kg).
vital_height - Height (cm).
vital_o2_saturation - O2 saturation (%).
history_of_present_illness (HPI) - Text, max 10000. Narrative of the present illness.
physical_exam_findings - Text, max 10000. Physical examination findings.
assessment - Text, max 10000. Diagnosis/assessment.
treatment_plan - Text, max 10000. Planned treatment.
orders_summary - Text, max 10000. Summary of orders placed.
disposition - String. Outcome: Discharged, Admitted, Referred, Follow-up, etc.
next_follow_up_date - Date. Follow-up appointment date.

text: The openVitals($id) + saveVitals() methods handle nursing vitals entry. When nursing saves vitals:

items: Loads the consultation by ID.
Pre-populates all vital fields from the existing record.

On saveVitals(): Updates vital_bp_systolic, vital_bp_diastolic, vital_heart_rate, vital_temperature, vital_respiratory_rate, vital_weight, vital_height, vital_o2_saturation, chief_complaint, AND sets status to 'In Progress' if currently 'Pending'.
Uses updated_by = current user ID, updated_date = now().
Flashes 'Vitals saved successfully.'
This is the Nursing role's primary function in OPD - entering vitals and chief complaint.
Updates: history_of_present_illness, physical_exam_findings, assessment, treatment_plan, orders_summary, disposition, next_follow_up_date.
Sets status: if disposition is set, status becomes 'Completed'. Otherwise stays 'In Progress'.
Uses updated_by = current user ID, updated_date = now().
Flashes 'Consultation notes saved.'
Then re-loads the consultation (treatConsultation) to refresh the form with updated data and refreshed order lists.

text: From the OPD consultation, doctors can place 5 types of orders. Each order creates a request record linked to the consultation. All order placement happens inside DB::transaction for atomicity.

items: Generates request code: 'LR-' + 5-digit zero-padded sequence based on count of existing LabRequests for the tenant.
Finds the 'Laboratory' department for requesting_department_id.

Creates LabRequest with: tenant_id, opd_consultation_id (current consultation), patient_id (from consultation), request_code, requesting_department_id (lab department), requesting_doctor_id (current user's HCP), priority (orderPriority, default 'Routine'), status = 'Pending', request_notes, created_by, updated_by.

For each selected test (orderSelection array): Creates LabRequestItem with: lab_request_id, item_type = 'Test', lab_test_id, test_name (from lab test), charge_amount (from test->standard_charge ?? 0), created_by, updated_by. Accumulates total_charge.
Updates LabRequest total_charge after all items created.
Closes modal, refreshes consultation view (treatConsultation).
Generates request code: 'PR-' + 5-digit zero-padded sequence.

Creates PharmacyRequest with: tenant_id, opd_consultation_id, request_code, requesting_department_id, requesting_person (user's full_name or jwt_user.full_name), requesting_doctor_id, priority, status = 'Pending', notes, created_by, updated_by.

For each selected drug: Creates PharmacyRequestItem with drug details, quantity (orderQuantities[$drugId] ?? 1), frequency (orderFrequencies[$drugId]), route (orderRoutes[$drugId]), created_by, updated_by.
Closes modal, refreshes consultation.
Generates request code: 'CR-' + 5-digit zero-padded sequence.
Creates CsrRequest with: tenant_id, opd_consultation_id, request_code, requesting_department_id, requesting_person, priority, status = 'Pending', notes.
For each selected CSR item: Creates CsrRequestItem with item details, quantity (orderCsrQuantities[$itemId]), notes.
Closes modal, refreshes consultation.
Generates request code: 'Rad-' + 5-digit zero-padded sequence.
Creates RadiologyRequest with: tenant_id, opd_consultation_id, request_code, requesting_department_id, requesting_person, requesting_doctor_id, priority, status = 'Pending', notes.
For each selected exam: Creates RadiologyRequestItem with exam type, modality, body part, notes.
Closes modal, refreshes consultation.
Generates request code: 'Proc-' + 5-digit zero-padded sequence.
Creates ProcedureRequest with: tenant_id, opd_consultation_id, request_code, requesting_department_id, requesting_person, priority, status = 'Pending', notes.
For each selected procedure: Creates ProcedureRequestItem with procedure details, quantity, notes.
Closes modal, refreshes consultation.
Shows all OPD consultations for the current tenant with pagination (perPage=10).
Search by patient name or consultation code.
Sort by consultation_datetime (default desc), patient name, status, etc.
Row actions: View SOAP notes, Enter Vitals (nursing), Place Orders (lab/pharmacy/CSR/radiology/procedure), Edit, Delete.
Status indicators: Pending (yellow), In Progress (blue), Completed (green).
